app.changelog:
Stryker 6.5. After the update, Stryker installs a new Linux system (about 320 MB).

New
- A second Linux engine: UML. It is lighter and starts faster than the virtual machine.
- Stryker checks your phone and picks the engine for you.
- Wi-Fi can now run inside Linux, for adapters Android has no driver for. Root still runs everything else.
- A Wordlists screen: download, make, clean and read wordlists.
- A hash cracker. Pick a hash, pick a wordlist, press start.
- A live attack screen with every step and the numbers.
- The USB screen shows where your adapter stops: port, Android, VM or wlan.
- You choose which tools you see on the dashboard.
- "Send diagnostics" puts all logs in one file for bug reports.
- Chinese translation.

Changed
- New setup screens. Stryker talks to Linux over SSH now.
- The VM disk grows by itself when it fills up.
- New look for the dashboard and the settings.

Fixed
- Update from 6.0.x works: the old Linux image is removed and the new one installed. Your settings stay.
- OnlineHashCrack uploads work again.
- Deauth on the internal Wi-Fi radio is now a setting you can turn on.

news.title: Stryker 6.5 - UML engine & Wi-Fi in Linux
news.description: A second rootless engine: User Mode Linux boots as a normal process, with no CPU emulation, and Stryker now probes the device and picks the engine itself. Wi-Fi can run inside Linux for adapters Android has no driver for, while root keeps running everything else. Also new: a Wordlists manager, a hash cracker, a live attack monitor, a USB chain that shows where an adapter stops, a customizable dashboard, diagnostics export and a Chinese translation. arm64-v8a only.

news.title: Stryker 6.0 - Rootless engine & Debian
news.description: The full toolset now runs without root: Stryker boots an arm64 QEMU virtual machine and routes tools into the guest. The chroot moved from Alpine to Debian trixie, the same rootfs the VM boots. Also new: a root-free network scanner (mDNS, SSDP, NetBIOS, SNMP), Cameradar RTSP discovery, a reworked dashboard and VM settings. RouterScan has been removed. arm64-v8a only.

news.title: StrykerOSS is open source
news.description: Released as free and open-source software. Visit the GitHub repository for source, issues and contributions.
